review_description: No assistance with grid connection.  My phone calls all go to a message bank, that gives no reply. No follow up to assist customer.  My bills have not decreased, I'm very unsatisfied and disappointed in the investment.

True Value were absolutely useless . paid a large deposit then told that my inverter was not good enough. Waited 2 months for a refund then found Intelli, as cheap , but not good to deal with. The independent installer was good .
